title: Mrs. Doubtfire Is Releasing on 4K This September – Here’s Where to Preorder It
snippet: Mrs. Doubtfire, the beloved comedy starring Robin Williams, is officially getting a 4K release on September 29. Here's where it's available to preorder and what bonus features it comes with.

title: Bitcoin heads for third winning week in a row as macro pressures mount
snippet: Bitcoin headed for its third straight winning week, as traders searched for refuge amid volatile moves in equities, currencies and bond markets.

title: Odyssey Translator Emily Wilson, Who Slammed Nolan's Movie, Retranslating Homer’s Epic From Scratch
snippet: Translator Emily Wilson is retranslating Homer's The Odyssey from scratch, following her viral critiques calling Christopher Nolan's blockbuster film adaptation "abysmal."

title: China hits back at G20 statement on its reliance on exports, accusing them of 'promoting protectionism'
snippet: China rejected G20 pressure over export-driven growth while also challenging U.S. Iran sanctions and European trade measures.

title: New York Fed's Williams says yield surge due to strong economic prospects
snippet: New York Fed President John Williams said higher Treasury yields reflect a strong economy as he weighs whether another interest rate hike is needed.

title: Berkshire CEO Greg Abel says Japanese bond yields not a challenge for trading houses right now
snippet: In an appearance on CNBC's "Squawk Box," Greg Abel said that yields in the country are still relatively low.

title: Nepal’s mountain tourism industry faces ‘serious warning’ after Himalayan flood disaster
snippet: Nepal's devastating floods have raised fresh concerns for the country's vital adventure tourism industry ahead of its peak travel season.

title: Hugging Face's new duck robot is selling fast. A Chinese chip powers it
snippet: The colorful "Microduck" robot from HuggingFace's French subsidiary Pollen Robotics has sold more than 10,000 units since launching on Thursday.

title: Prediction market traders think job creation rebounded in August
snippet: Traders see 50-50 odds that the U.S. economy added more than 50,000 jobs last month.

title: China's Xi builds diplomatic clout with multiple state visits ahead of Trump summit
snippet: Chinese President Xi Jinping is expected to make his first visit to India before traveling to the U.S. for a meeting with U.S. President Donald Trump.

title: Fed Governor Barr says he'll support rate hike if inflation doesn't ease
snippet: The policymaker said he's concerned about "broader price pressures taking hold" as inflation has prevailed above the Fed's 2% target.
